text:
olivia: Hey team  quick follow-up from today's all-hands: packing the Q&A notes, immediate actions, and a couple of clarifications so we don't lose momentum. I'll keep this thread updated. :clipboard:

jordan: Thanks! Can you clarify the SLA banding for Dedicated? Someone asked if there's a "gold" tier with 99.9% latency SLO + dedicated support?

olivia: Good point. Short answer: launch tiers = standard & enterprise. Enterprise includes 99.9% uptime SLA on reserved pools, a faster support SLT, and optional priority routing. We'll publish an SLA matrix in the docs. Target publish date: 2025-09-15.

priya: Request from PMs in chat: are we shipping a migration guide for customers moving from hosted to Dedicated? They want recommended steps, downtime expectations, and a sample config.

jen: We'll need a step-by-step with a rollback plan. Some customers will want a canary migration pattern (traffic split) + KV cache warmup notes.

tom: Also add a little script example for traffic split via the API. Something like:

```bash
# split 10% to dedicated pool
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routing/split \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -d '{"route":"prod/generate","splits":[{"target":"dedicated:us-west","pct":10},{"target":"hosted:default","pct":90}]}'
```

priya: Perfect, Tom. Can you commit that snippet to the migration doc?

tom: Yep, will add. ETA: tomorrow.

infra-bot: deploy: docs/migration -> staging (build #8942) started 2025-09-16T15:12:00Z

jordan: One more ask on Dedicated capacity: what are the default autoscaling thresholds? Customer success needs numbers for sizing conversations.

olivia: Default autoscale = min 1 / target 4 / max 20 for a reserved pool, burst pool separate. We'll add a recommended sizing table per workload profile (low-latency chat, high-throughput batch). Carlos on sales will get the table for customer conversations.

priya: About observability: Q from infra team will the console show per-model token spend by default or is that an opt-in?

olivia: We'll expose per-route and per-model token breakdown by default in the console for org admins. Billing export will also include per-model columns. Pushed to GA notes.

jen: Action item: I'll own the migration guide + rollback checklist. Tagging myself in Notion.

tom: Action item: I'll add the API snippet, sample traffic split config, and an example KV warmup job.

jordan: Action item: I'll coordinate the SLA matrix with legal + support and upload to GH issue #4621.

priya: Action item: I'll draft the observability UX copy and sample screenshots for the console team.

infra-bot: ticket_update: GH #4621 SLA matrix created by jordan. Status: triage.

olivia: Quick clarifications from leadership Q&A: 1) Dedicated GA date = 2025-09-15, 2) On-prem air-gapped for enterprise is targeted for 2025-11-01 but depends on certs, 3) Console retention defaults = 30d traces / 90d metrics (notes copied from infra).

jordan: Can we add a short customer-facing FAQ bullet about fallback behavior (Dedicated -> hosted) for cases when reserved capacity is exhausted? There was confusion during the live Q&A.

olivia: Yes. Default behavior = do not fallback automatically for Dedicated unless customer enables 'allow-hosted-fallback' in their org settings. We'll include the pros/cons in the FAQ.

tom: FYI I already have one customer asking for a migration dry-run environment. Could we make a short-term sandbox for partners?

olivia: Good idea. @ops: can we spin a partners sandbox for early migrations? I'll open an infra request and link here.

infra-bot: infra_request: partners-sandbox ticket opened (#5778). Owner: priya.

jen: Small ask  can we get a sample TCO spreadsheet to show customers comparing hosted vs dedicated? I'll work with finance briefly.

jordan: I can share a template used in EMEA deals.

olivia: Summary of immediate owners: jen (migration guide + rollback), tom (API snippets + KV warmup examples), jordan (SLA matrix & legal), priya (console UX copy + partners sandbox). I'll maintain the live action list in Notion and ping owners weekly. Notion link: https://notion.redwood.internal/allhands/ah-2025-09-16-followups (internal)

tom: I'll also add the traffic-split script to the docs PR. PR link will be in this thread when ready.

jordan: Can we do a 30-min sync 48h from now to check blockers? Very narrow agenda: SLA, migration guide status, partners sandbox.

olivia: Scheduling poll: https://cal.com/olivia/ah-followup-48h  please pick a time.

priya: Noted. I'll update GH #4283 with the observability alerting scope too.

olivia: Thanks everyone  this was super helpful. If you raised a question and don't see it here, reply and I'll add. Closing for now but will post updates. :white_check_mark:
